narration_segments.caption: This AI-drafted story has two planted errors. NoCap flags both, with the filed figures.

narration_segments.caption: NoCap checks every financial number in a draft against SEC filings.

narration_segments.caption: Muse Spark pulls out each claim. Code checks every one against the filings.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Muse Spark pulls out each claim. Code checks every one against the filings.

narration_segments.caption: Seven verified. Two wrong. Two unverifiable, because NoCap won't guess.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Seven verified. Two wrong. Two unverifiable, because No Cap won't guess.

narration_segments.caption: The draft says revenue grew 18% from a year ago. That's the quarterly rate.
narration_segments.spoken_text: The draft says revenue grew eighteen percent from a year ago. That's the quarterly rate.

narration_segments.caption: The receipt does the math from the filings: 105.85%.
narration_segments.spoken_text: The receipt does the math from the filings: one hundred five point eight five percent.

narration_segments.caption: Each receipt cites the filing, down to when EDGAR accepted it.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Each receipt cites the filing, down to when Edgar accepted it.

narration_segments.caption: And $2.22 is adjusted EPS. The GAAP figure was $2.46.
narration_segments.spoken_text: And two twenty-two is adjusted earnings per share. The gap figure was two forty-six.

narration_segments.caption: Fix with receipts: Muse Wonder proposes corrected numbers, and code lets only the digits change.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Fix with receipts. Muse Wonder proposes corrected numbers, and code lets only the digits change.

narration_segments.caption: Then the whole draft is checked again: nine verified, zero wrong.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Then the whole draft is checked again. Nine verified, zero wrong.

narration_segments.caption: Each correction keeps its receipt.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Each correction keeps its receipt.

narration_segments.caption: Time travel: check this roundup as of July 29, 4 p.m. UTC.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Time travel. Check this roundup as of July twenty-ninth, four P M, U T C.

narration_segments.caption: Microsoft's revenue figure is right, but its filing reached EDGAR hours later, so it's marked not public yet.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Microsoft's revenue figure is right, but its filing reached Edgar hours later, so it's marked not public yet.

narration_segments.caption: Now a real SEC slide: Bank of America's earnings presentation.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Now a real S E C slide. Bank of America's earnings presentation.

narration_segments.caption: Its recorded live run: three model calls, 21 seconds, about three cents.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Its recorded live run: three model calls, twenty-one seconds, about three cents.

narration_segments.caption: SAM 3.1 finds both bar charts, and Muse Spark reads 32 printed labels.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Sam three point one finds both bar charts, and Muse Spark reads thirty-two printed labels.

narration_segments.caption: Only the five GAAP bars verify. The rest are non-GAAP, untracked or ambiguous, so they stay unverifiable.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Only the five gap bars verify. The rest are non-gap, untracked or ambiguous, so they stay unverifiable.

narration_segments.caption: Each reading opens its receipt.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Each reading opens its receipt.

narration_segments.caption: Ask a question of Meta's entire 10-K: more than half a million characters.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Ask a question of Meta's entire ten K. More than half a million characters.

narration_segments.caption: One Muse Spark request reads all of it in six seconds: 101,135 input tokens, no retrieval, no truncation.
narration_segments.spoken_text: One Muse Spark request reads all of it in six seconds. A hundred and one thousand input tokens, no retrieval, no truncation.

narration_segments.caption: Code keeps only exact quotes it can find in the filing.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Code keeps only exact quotes it can find in the filing.

narration_segments.caption: Same verifier, four backends: Spark Open found all 27 gold claims, and Glimmer reads unpublished drafts on our own GPU.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Same verifier, four back ends. Spark Open found all twenty-seven gold claims, and Glimmer reads unpublished drafts on our own G P U.

narration_segments.caption: Private check runs on Glimmer: one real run on our own Modal GPU, one figure verified, one planted error caught.
narration_segments.spoken_text: Private check runs on Glimmer: one real run on our own Modal G P U, one figure verified, one planted error caught.

narration_segments.caption: On held-out tests, NoCap caught 44 of 48 planted errors, with one false alarm in 47 clean sentences.
narration_segments.spoken_text: On held-out tests, No Cap caught forty-four of forty-eight planted errors, with one false alarm in forty-seven clean sentences.
